Net radiation of the reference surface

Source: R/reference-et.R
ef_ref_net_radiation.Rd

Computes the net radiation \(R_n\) of the hypothetical reference surface of FAO-56 (albedo 0.23) and its components, the net shortwave radiation \(R_{ns}\) and the net outgoing longwave radiation \(R_{nl}\), for a daily or an hourly time step. It is the net radiation entering ef_ref_et() and ef_ref_soil_heat_flux(); it is not the net radiation of a pixel (ef_net_radiation()).

Usage

ef_ref_net_radiation(
  solar_radiation,
  clear_sky_radiation,
  vapour_pressure,
  air_temperature = NULL,
  tmax = NULL,
  tmin = NULL,
  timestep,
  cloudiness = NULL
)

Arguments

solar_radiation

Numeric. Measured (or estimated) solar radiation \(R_s\) of the period [MJ m-2 d-1 or MJ m-2 h-1]. Must be finite and >= 0.

clear_sky_radiation

Numeric or NULL. Clear-sky radiation \(R_{so}\) of the same period and unit, from ef_rso(). Must be finite and > 0 where the cloudiness term is computed from \(R_s/R_{so}\). May be NULL only when cloudiness is supplied.

vapour_pressure

Numeric. Actual vapour pressure \(e_a\) [kPa] of the period (from ef_ea_daily() or ef_ea_rh()). Must be finite and >= 0.

air_temperature

Numeric or NULL. Mean hourly air temperature [degrees Celsius], required for timestep = "hourly" (and NULL for "daily"). Must be finite and > -273.16.

tmax, tmin

Numeric or NULL. Daily maximum and minimum air temperatures [degrees Celsius], required for timestep = "daily" (and NULL for "hourly"). Finite, > -273.16 and tmin <= tmax.

timestep

Character, no default. "daily" (FAO-56 Eq. 39) or "hourly" (FAO-56 chapter 4, "Hourly time step").

cloudiness

Numeric or NULL. The cloudiness term \(f = 1.35 R_s/R_{so} - 0.35\) [-] to use instead of computing it from solar_radiation and clear_sky_radiation, in [-0.35, 1]. It serves night-time periods, where \(R_{so} = 0\) and FAO-56 carries the ratio of a period before sunset (see Details). When supplied it is used at every position. Default NULL: computed from the radiation.

Value

An object of class earthflux_reference_net_radiation: a list with

  • rn: net radiation of the reference surface \(R_n\);

  • rns: net shortwave radiation \(R_{ns}\);

  • rnl: net outgoing longwave radiation \(R_{nl}\);

  • cloudiness: the cloudiness term \(f\) used [-];

all numeric [MJ m-2 d-1 or MJ m-2 h-1, the unit of solar_radiation] with the common length (and dim) of the inputs;

  • timestep;

  • flags: list of earthflux_flag records (record scope) for the codes that hold somewhere: EF_INPUT_NA (a required input is missing) and EF_WS_RS_RSO_LIMITED (\(R_s/R_{so} > 1\), limited to 1 in the cloudiness term);

  • provenance: time step, verification status, constants, source of the cloudiness term, references, flags_evaluated and package version.

Details

$$R_{ns} = (1 - \alpha) R_s, \quad \alpha = 0.23$$ (FAO-56, chapter 3, Eq. 38; albedo of the grass reference), $$R_{nl} = \sigma \frac{T_{max,K}^4 + T_{min,K}^4}{2} (0.34 - 0.14 \sqrt{e_a}) \left(1.35 \frac{R_s}{R_{so}} - 0.35\right)$$ with \(\sigma\) = 4.903e-9 MJ K-4 m-2 d-1 and \(T_K = T + 273.16\) (FAO-56, chapter 3, Eq. 39), and \(R_n = R_{ns} - R_{nl}\) (Eq. 40). For the hourly time step (FAO-56, chapter 4, "Hourly time step") the mean of the fourth powers is replaced by \(T_{hr,K}^4\) and \(\sigma = 4.903 \times 10^{-9}/24\) = 2.043e-10 MJ K-4 m-2 h-1.

Limit Rs/Rso <= 1. FAO-56 defines Eq. 39 with \(R_s/R_{so} \le 1\). The limit is applied only inside the cloudiness term; solar_radiation and rns are not modified, and the positions where it acts are flagged EF_WS_RS_RSO_LIMITED. The lower limit of 0.3 attributed to ASCE-EWRI (2005) by secondary implementations is CANDIDATA and is not applied.

Night-time periods. With \(R_{so} = 0\) the ratio is undefined. FAO-56 sets it to the value of a period 2-3 hours before sunset, identified by \(\omega_s - 0.79 \le \omega \le \omega_s - 0.52\), or, approximately, to 0.4-0.6 in humid and sub-humid and 0.7-0.8 in arid and semi-arid climates (0.3 means complete cloud cover). Selecting that value is the task of the station orchestration; here the resulting term is passed as cloudiness (for a ratio \(r\), cloudiness = 1.35 * r - 0.35).

Normative constants (decision WF-14): \(\sigma\) of FAO-56 (4.903e-9 MJ m-2 d-1 K-4, about 5.6748e-8 W m-2 K-4, 0.08 % below the CODATA value used elsewhere in the package) and 273.16 in the conversion to kelvin, as written in Eq. 39; the package constants (EF_STEFAN_BOLTZMANN, 273.15) are not used inside the reference surface equations. \(R_{nl}\) is an empirical longwave balance of the reference surface and is not interchangeable with the incoming and emitted longwave radiation of a pixel.

Missing values propagate (and are flagged EF_INPUT_NA). Missing, unknown or inconsistent timestep and temperature arguments raise earthflux_missing_input, earthflux_unknown_method or earthflux_input_error; values outside the domains above (including \(R_{so} = 0\) without cloudiness, and tmin > tmax) raise earthflux_domain_error.

Verification status

VERIFICADA (FAO-56, chapter 3, Eqs. 38-40; chapter 4, hourly time step; cases V10, V11, V14, V15 and V16 of dev/specs/weather-forcing.md 8.1).

References

Allen, R. G., Pereira, L. S., Raes, D., & Smith, M. (1998). Crop evapotranspiration: Guidelines for computing crop water requirements (FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56). FAO, Rome. ISBN 92-5-104219-5.

See also

Other reference evapotranspiration functions: ef_ref_et(), ef_ref_soil_heat_flux()

Examples

# FAO-56 example 18 (Uccle, 6 July): daily step
rn <- ef_ref_net_radiation(
  solar_radiation = 22.07, clear_sky_radiation = 30.90,
  vapour_pressure = 1.409, tmax = 21.5, tmin = 12.3, timestep = "daily"
)
rn$rn
#> [1] 13.28291

# FAO-56 example 19, 02:00-03:00: night, Rs/Rso = 0.8 carried
ef_ref_net_radiation(
  solar_radiation = 0, clear_sky_radiation = NULL,
  vapour_pressure = 3.402, air_temperature = 28, timestep = "hourly",
  cloudiness = 1.35 * 0.8 - 0.35
)$rn
#> [1] -0.1003213
